the_prediction_made_in_advance: r73, written before any work: 'a proper goal parser at zero model calls should move 11.5% by roughly 4-6x. That is the next round, and it is a measurable prediction I am making in advance.'
the_reasoning_behind_it: 113/130 tasks expose usable structure (86.9%, measured) while only 43 goals were attempted. The headroom looked like 2.6x by that count alone.

the_result.verdict: FALSIFIED, and in the opposite direction. Four attempts, no attempt beat the baseline.

why_it_was_wrong.measured_before_tuning_stopped: diagnostic_v1.json: 7 of 8 sampled failures had a target NOT ON SCREEN before a disclosure step
why_it_was_wrong.the_binding_constraint: ORDERING, not parsing. click-collapsible-2 needs expand->find the link inside->click. click-dialog needs the button labelled 'Close' when the goal says 'x'. click-pie draws its items into an SvgRoot with no child nodes and no roles at all.
why_it_was_wrong.the_shape_of_the_mistake: I treated 'the page offers structure' as 'the page offers structure RIGHT NOW'. 86.9% addressability was measured at one instant, after the page settled. Most of the unclaimed tasks need the screen to change before the target exists.

the_second_mistake_repeated.what: four rounds of edits, each scored on the same 130 goals I had read
the_second_mistake_repeated.why_it_is_the_same_error_as_r69: a lexicon tuned on the probes it is scored on. Here, a parser tuned on the goals it is scored on.
the_second_mistake_repeated.the_mitigation: heldout_goals_v1.json: 20 goals from a template grammar, never present in MiniWob, scored separately
the_second_mistake_repeated.heldout_misses: h05 and h06 (lists without a leading 'and' read as one name), h15 (now unseen), h16 ('the 3rd option' read as a name -- should refuse)

the_leak_that_the_test_caught.what: h15 was a verbatim MiniWob goal, copied from click-dialog
the_leak_that_the_test_caught.how: test_heldout_goals_do_not_appear_in_the_benchmark, which exists because a leaked held-out item is not held out
the_leak_that_the_test_caught.action: replaced, both numbers kept in the record

the_lesson.one_line: the parser was never the bottleneck. The screen not yet showing what the sentence refers to was the bottleneck.
the_lesson.the_law_it_extends: r70 said a demonstration reduces to slots, roles and structure. r74 adds: a STRUCTURE may not exist yet. An agent that can only act on what it can see at this instant is capped by how much of the screen is already open.

what_this_does_not_prove: that ordering is the only remaining constraint
next: measure the ordering constraint directly: for every unsolved task, does the target exist before any action?
if the answer is 'no' for most, the next mechanism is reveal-then-act as a first-class plan, not a fallback
keep the 15/130 baseline honest: it is still the best zero-model number on this suite
